Type: matte stoneware vases, set of two
Use: holding stems or dried flowers; living room, bedroom, home office, on a shelf or side table
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: stoneware, smooth matte glaze
Colors: warm off-white, muted blue-green
Shape: small teardrop pebble body, slanted oval opening, smooth unadorned surface, compact
Feel: calm, soft, organic
Goes with: light wood, linen, sage and neutral tones; Scandinavian or Japandi rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Stoneware Vases, 2-Piece Set, 5.2"H, White and Blue-Green
product.description: With their unique asymmetrical design, these 2 ceramic vases will infuse your interior space with a fresh and clean feeling. Display them on their own as a home-accent piece, or fill them with artificial flowers or greenery. 4.46"D x 3.54"W x 5.2"H 100% stoneware Crafted of fine ceramic, these vases have a glossy glazed surface that adds an elegant touch to any color scheme and decor. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
